TYPE MISMATCH - Addition does not work with this value:

11|                     prop1 + prop2 + val + field2
                                        #^^^#
This `val` value is a:

    #Maybe
        { d
            | field1 : Maybe { a | prop1 : number, prop2 : number }
            , field2 : b
            , field3 : c
        }#

But (+) only works with #Int# and #Float# values.

#Hint#: Only #Int# and #Float# values work as numbers.
